tldr: A BOF where experienced speakers share how to start speaking at conferences: choosing topics, writing accepted proposals, preparing material and delivering a talk.
summary: The session sets out to answer the questions a first-time speaker has: where to start, which topic to pick and how to deliver a talk that lands. A group of experienced speakers, hosted by Bert Jan Schrijver, share their own experience in an open, conversational format.

Topics include writing proposals that get accepted, preparing material and delivering the presentation, along with what worked, what did not and the lessons learned. The stated aim is for attendees to leave with practical takeaways and the confidence to submit a first proposal.
keyPoints: Experienced speakers discuss how to get started and which topic to pick.
Covers writing conference proposals that get accepted.
Covers preparing material and delivering a good presentation.
Speakers share what worked and what did not.
takeaways: Draft a proposal for a first talk and submit it to a conference or meetup.
watchIf: You would like to speak at a conference but do not know where to begin.
